reviews.text: I called Dominik (tearfully and desperately) less than a week into having our 6 month old rescue puppy, who is a mix of working breeds including German shorthair pointer. We knew Birdie was very smart and had a lot of potential, but we had no idea how to properly parent her and found ourselves extremely overwhelmed with her energy, zoomies, and teenage testing phase. After just a few sessions with Dominik and following his methods, we felt like we had a different dog. We were able to understand what motivates her, how to better structure her days and exercise her, and overall how to communicate more effectively with her. Dominik instantly recognized Birdie’s high potential and effectively coached us in how to train her and show leadership. We now have a dog who is able to listen and relax and settle and with whom we are able to have a fun, rewarding relationship with. I truly don’t know if we would have been able to get to this place, particularly in NYC, without Dominik. We are very grateful! Dominik is responsive, helpful, clear, and able to understand both dogs and humans effectively!

Working with Dominik has been a game-changer for our (almost) 1 year and a half Vizsla. As any Vizsla owner knows, they are incredibly high-energy and sensitive, which can make training a challenge. Dominik’s balanced, common-sense approach was exactly what we needed. He helped us establish clear boundaries and solid obedience while still respecting our pup’s unique personality. The transformation in his focus, recall, leash walking and manners is night and day. If you’re looking for a trainer who truly understands dog behavior (especially for high-drive breeds) we cannot recommend Dominik enough!

We can’t recommend Dominik highly enough! We came to him because our dog Obi had developed guarding behaviors that were starting to worry us. Dominik’s approach was calm, knowledgeable, and worked really well for him.

Obi is so much more relaxed and confident now, and Dominik taught us the tools we needed to help reinforce these behaviors.

If you’re looking for a trainer who genuinely gets dogs, look no further!

Seeing my dog Marco through Dominik’s eyes, I was able to watch this overwrought, anxious doggo relax into easy and consistent good behavior—it’s a beautiful thing! The depth Dominik brings to the process is impressive and thought-provoking—a great experience.

We highly recommend Dominik. We started working with him shortly after getting our puppy, Morty. We signed up for the puppy package and we could see the progress after each session. He helped us through potty and crate training as well as walking on a leash and learning basic commands.

One of the most important things is that he has helped us make Morty into a very resilient dog.

We have had such a good experience that we signed up for an additional package. We are looking forward to working on higher level commands and behaviors with Dominik and Morty loves him!

Dominik has been insanely helpful at getting us to a better spot with our Mini Australian Shepherd. Living in the city with a working breed has been a challenge, but he's given us the tools and understanding on how to best communicate and create a stronger bond with our dog. She's been much less reactive, calmer walking on the leash, and has gotten SO much better at controlling her impulses and checking in with us. Definitely would recommend Dominik to anyone who wants a professional that understands dogs, their breed specific tendencies, and can teach actionable steps to make our relationship stronger and more trusting. He's been great.

TLDR: If you’re on the fence and dealing with a challenging dog, don’t overthink it. Just book him. Even the initial evaluation alone is worth it.

When I first met Dominik, I was anxious and frustrated and so was my dog. We had no real way to communicate beyond using treats to distract or lure her.

I have a 10-month-old Dalmatian rescue with reactivity and behavioral challenges. I started training early at 3 months old and she did well initially, but by 5–6 months things started to unravel. She was struggling with leash reactivity, elevator triggers, and group settings like daycare and dog parks.

Like a lot of owners, I initially leaned heavily on positive reinforcement. And while that can be great for very young puppies, I reached a point where it wasn’t enough for my dog. She needed clearer communication, structure, and accountability not just redirection.

I tried a positive-only trainer first, and after a few sessions it was clear it wasn’t working for her.

Within just two sessions with Dominik, I saw a dramatic shift.

A concrete example: before working with him, passing another dog on leash or getting into the elevator almost always meant pulling, fixating, and reacting. It was stressful every time. Now, she can walk past dogs calmly and ride the elevator without escalating, checking in with me instead of making her own decisions. That alone has completely changed our day-to-day life.

He introduced tools like the prong collar, which I was initially hesitant about. I worried it might increase aggression or stress. The opposite happened. Under Dominik’s guidance, it became a communication tool that gave my dog clarity. She started to understand expectations, regulate herself, and look to me for direction instead of reacting to everything around her.

The result is a dog who is more confident, calmer, and genuinely happier and that carries over even when she’s not wearing the collar.

What stands out most is how Dominik teaches. He’s clear, methodical, and never rushes. He demonstrates everything, then coaches you through it so you actually know what you’re doing as an owner. That part is huge. He's also realistic about how long things will take because nothing is immediate, but in the long-run so worth it.

I started with a 6-session package and have already extended to continue working with him on e-collar training. He's changed my entire outlook/relationship with my dog.

I can’t say enough about how helpful Dominik’s training style has helped us with our extremely fearful dog. We went from not being able to have guests in the home without constant barking and a scared dog to our dog calmly staying on her bed and being able to greet guests when she is calm and ready. He also gave us the tools to tackle other fears and bring calmness into our dogs life (and our own.) I highly recommend!
Dominik has gotten our dog on the right track and we saw near immediate improvements.

We brought Dominik in to help with my 4 year old Shih Tzu - Vinnie. The training surrounded the way Vinnie approaches people when they enter and exit our apartment (rushing the door, barking at guests). His guidance is proving to be extremely valuable as Vinnie learns he does not need to protect our family from everyone coming into our apt. Thanks and highly recommend.

My fiancé and I are raising a 2 y/o long hair German shepherd named Parker. The best decision we’ve ever made was working with Dom. Parker has always been high energy & lacked a little focus which inevitably lead to some reactivity and over protection of us, and an increase in our anxiety with him. Working with Dominic really changed how we live with Parker and we are now able to give him the best life possible in city. We went from struggling on walks to completely off leash in the park, incredible behavior change & just overall happier pup which makes us happy! We have entered a new chapter of enjoying being dog parents, and we give that credit to Dom and the work we’ve all done together.

I can’t recommend Dominik highly enough. From the very session, it was clear how knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested he was in both our dog and us. The training sessions are well-structured and tailored to my dog’s personality and needs.

The progress we’ve seen has been incredible — not just in obedience but in confidence and overall behavior. What really sets Dominik apart from the rest is his ability to explain why certain behaviors occur and why his technique works, which made it easy to stay consistent between sessions. He truly cares about both my dog and I success.

If you are looking for a trainer who deliver reals results while making the process positive and rewarding, look no further. I can’t express enough how working with Dominik was truly one of the best investments I’ve made for myself and my pup!

Dominik helped us a great deal in improving our relationship with Leia and gave us tips to make our daily life and walks more enjoyable. In just 6 sessions, we saw many improvements, and Leia loved Dominik!

I reached out to Dominik after adopting a three-year-old mini dachshund that had been raised in the countryside. Adjusting to city life with all of its inherent chaos was challenging for Bibi and ended up causing anxiety, reactivity, and what Dominik helped me realize was resource guarding of me. Dominik was the second trainer I tried, and after an initial pack of six sessions and some one-off tune-ups, I cannot recommend him enough. He was patient with Bibi and, more importantly, me, teaching us both the tools we need to stay calm and concentrated in both everyday life and higher-stress moments.

I could not have been more proud of Bibi when I had a handyman come to the apartment the other day. Her initial instinct was to bark at him and defend her space, but I immediately put into practice our training, sending her to her “place” and rewarding her accordingly. She stayed focused on me from there on out, ignoring the man as he worked and almost forgetting he was there. Truly incredible!

It’s obviously only as effective as the amount of practice you put in and we still have some work to do, but we are so far from where we started!

We had a great experience with Dominik. After meeting our pup he promptly set up a game plan that helped us address our dog’s leash reactivity and resource guarding issues. If you’re willing to put in consistent work the results will absolutely come with time. Dominik is an expert at what he does, and he’s easy to learn from. We would recommend him to anyone seeking to improve their dog’s behavior.

Dominik is an outstanding dog trainer. He understands dogs better than anyone I’ve ever met and has a highly effective and science-based approach to training that worked extremely well for our dog. Would highly him recommend to anyone.

Dominik helped me and my pup in just three sessions. No more pulling during walks, leash aggression, and anxiety towards other dogs. Dominik primarily trained me, which seems to be the ultimate factor for our success.

Working with Dominik has been a game changer for my dog's recall and general obedience. It isn't easy to find a behaviorist who will incorporate training aids like ecollars for added safety off-leash, but Dominik's program does, and I greatly appreciate his ethical and compassionate approach to providing this balanced training. I also appreciate him traveling out of his way for our sessions, and his flexibility in allowing me to make game time decisions about keeping or rescheduling our sessions when the weather is looking rough. Overall, I've seen results since day one and learned a lot along the way. He is highly knowledgable and I'm amazed at how far we've come with his help. Thank you Dominik!

I have had Toby for 4 years and struggled to find a trainer that could really connect with Toby and solve some of his lingering issues- but Dominik did. Dominik gives a masterclass in dog psychology and helps you better understand how to interact with your dog to give them the best life and keep them happy. Our walks have become so much more enjoyable and his anxiety is definitely reduced. Dominik always made our sessions enjoyable and we looked forward to working with him. I would highly recommend him to anyone looking to improve their relationship with their dog or looking to help their dog manage their emotions/anxieties.

This will sound cliché, but working with Dominik has changed our lives. We called him after I ended up being pulled into the mud on a walk and realized we had hit a wall with Snow's reactivity.

Before training, Snow was slightly anxious, very reactive, and essentially hard to manage on walks. We felt overwhelmed and unsure of what to do next. and trust me, we had tried many things.

From the very first session, Dominik brought a sense of calm, confidence, and clarity. Not just to our dog, but to us as owners.

We started with a test session where Dominik took the time to understand Snow and her triggers. We then decided on a package of six sessions, which turned out to be incredibly effective. After just the first two sessions, Snow was a different dog — and I was a different leader. With each session, we saw tangible progress, not just in Snow’s behavior, but in how we interacted with her. We became more confident, more consistent, and more connected to her needs.

Walks are no longer a source of stress. Snow is more relaxed, more responsive, and we’re finally enjoying our time together outdoors.

We couldn’t recommend Dominik highly enough. If you're struggling or feeling stuck, don’t wait — working with him is one of the best decisions we’ve made for our dog and ourselves.
